name: Deoxys (Udyr)
creator: sauronkaiser
description:
Base champion: Udyr

Modified Skin: Default

Author: Sauronkaiser

Description: Deoxys from Pokemon

Features:

-New model and textures.

-New full set of animations.

-New sounds.

-New particles

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-Love/hate relationship with Rayquaza.

Sources:

-Models, textures and sounds extracted from different pokemon games.

-The taunt animation references the Youtuber/Streamer Knekro, who won the Pokemon competitive championship in Spain in the year 2000 using a Snorlax to defeat the enemy Mewtwo with self-destruct, and then got the third position in the international tournament.

-All animations made by me.
